title: Checks after the change
summary: Verification must describe the final relevant state.

sections.label: Recommended practice
sections.text: Record checks for the final relevant code or data state. Repeat affected checks after a subsequent change, and keep command success distinct from verification of the resulting content.

sections.label: Project adaptation
sections.text: Identify the candidate revision, dependency revisions, pipeline run, tested fixture or environment, and applicable quality results. For the workplace example, these include the Bitbucket commit, submodules, Jenkins run, and tested graph.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: The completion packet points to actual evidence for the candidate being reviewed, not a stale local success.

sections.label: Example source: Talos verification tests
sections.text: The inspected Talos test definitions require rejection of checks from before the last mutation, failed verification commands, build-only profiles, and ambiguous summaries. They also cover failed file readback despite command success. These test definitions were inspected, not executed.

confidence: High for test contents. Execution unverified, adaptation proposed

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
